categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen East Asia Machinery Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of air compressors, vacuum pumps, and related air power systems. Their product portfolio includes screw compressors (oil-free and oil-lubricated), centrifugal compressors, piston compressors, vacuum pumps, blowers, and supporting equipment such as dryers and filters. The company serves diverse industrial sectors including equipment manufacturing, automotive, semiconductor, photovoltaic, lithium battery, metallurgy, power, electronics, medical, textile, aerospace, military, food and beverage, and more.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies such as screw rotor design and manufacturing, permanent magnet variable frequency motors, magnetic levitation technology for centrifugal compressors, and IoT-enabled intelligent control systems ('Jaguar Smart Control'). They emphasize energy efficiency, oil-free compression technology, and digital manufacturing with MES and ERP integration. Production combines safety stock and order-based manufacturing with in-house capabilities covering rotor processing, motor assembly, and full machine assembly, supported by advanced automation and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large industrial enterprises across sectors like automotive, semiconductor, new energy, medical, electronics, metallurgy, and food processing. Notable clients include BYD, Inovance Technology, CATL, Faraday Electronics, Jiangfeng Electronics, and others. The company targets both domestic and international markets, with a strong focus on serving high-end and emerging industries requiring clean, efficient air power solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with a sales network concentrated in provinces such as Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Anhui, Shanxi, Hubei, Hebei, and Shaanxi, covering nationwide distribution. Export sales account for a smaller portion but are growing, with plans to expand overseas markets. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Xiamen, Fujian Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiamen East Asia Machinery Industrial Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and system integrator of air compressors and vacuum pumps. They design and produce core components like screw rotors and motors, assemble complete machines, and provide integrated air power system solutions, positioning themselves as a key equipment supplier to various industrial end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in energy-efficient, oil-free, and intelligent air compression technologies, focusing on permanent magnet variable frequency drives, magnetic levitation centrifugal compressors, and IoT-based smart control systems. R&D efforts target expanding high-end product lines such as vacuum pumps and large screw compressors, developing integrated air systems, and exploring new applications in robotics and data centers. They emphasize green manufacturing, digital transformation, and product upgrades aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of air compressors, vacuum pumps, and related equipment, including both direct sales to large customers and sales via a network of dealers. The company also earns income from after-sales services, maintenance, and government subsidies. Investment income from financial products contributes a minor portion. Sales are mostly one-time product sales with some recurring revenue from service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the air compressor industry, recognized as a 'specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative' (专精特新) 'little giant' enterprise. It competes with international brands in the high-end market but has made significant progress in domestic substitution through technological innovation and product quality. Its 'Jaguar' brand is well-regarded, and the company holds a strong market share in China, especially in energy-efficient and green products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.14 billion, representing an 18.91% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 217 million, up 33.23%. Total assets reached RMB 2.45 billion, growing 29.5% year-over-year. The company maintains a healthy growth trajectory with improving profitability and expanding production capacity, supported by ongoing investments in new facilities and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high energy efficiency, oil-free compression technology, and intelligent control systems as its core competitive advantages. Its products meet stringent national energy-saving standards and are recognized as 'energy efficiency leaders' with multiple national green manufacturing certifications. The integrated production capability and continuous innovation enable stable, reliable, and clean air power solutions tailored to high-end industrial applications, supporting customers' green and digital transformation needs.
